title: Freestanding Makeup Mirror 8-Inch Double Faced 2X Solid Brass | Allied Brass
short_title: Freestanding Makeup Mirror 8-Inch Double Faced 2X | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade daily grooming with a freestanding make-up mirror featuring an 8-Inch double faced mirror and 2X magnification for detailed viewing. Crafted from solid brass with a heavy base to help resist tipping, it’s designed for reliable countertop or floor placement in the bathroom and complements traditional bathroom hardware.

Highlights:
- Double-faced mirror glass with 2X magnification on one side for close-up makeup or shaving
- 1X mirror on the opposite side for an all-around view
- Freestanding design requires no wall mounting and moves easily where you need it
- Solid brass construction with a heavy base to help prevent tipping
- Felt pad helps protect surfaces from scratches

Specs:
- Category: Make-Up Mirrors
- Mirror size: 8-Inch diameter
- Material: Brass
- Mounting type: Freestanding
- Overall footprint: 10.5-Inch L x 10.5-Inch W
- Product weight: 13.6 lb
- Included: Make-up mirror
- Assembly required: Yes
- Finish options: Available in 25 designer finishes including statement colors

_previous.title: Adjustable Height Floor Standing Make-Up Mirror 8 Inch Diameter with 2X Magnification
_previous.description: Elegantly and efficiently designed, this floor standing 2 sided magnification mirror is an easy solution for your daily make-up or shaving routine.  The dual-sided mirror features a clear magnification for those close-up applications on one side and a 1x magnification on the opposite side for a quick all around check at any angle.  With classic accents, this free-standing vanity mirror is the crowning touch to your bathroom accessories.
